text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - High ephemeral storage eviction rate on gpu-node-7 (us-west-2). Multiple runtime pods crashed with CUDA init errors. Paging @oncall-team.

maya: seeing lots of 'evicted' events and kernel messages about writeback. stack traces show runtime exited with code 137 and CUDA driver warnings.

kyle: copying k8s events snippet:```Events:
  Type     Reason      Age   From               Message
  ----     ------      ----  ----               -------
  Warning  Evicted     2m    kubelet, gpu-node-7  Pod was evicted: the node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
  Warning  BackOff     1m    kubelet, gpu-node-7  Back-off restarting failed container
```

jordan: logs from runtime container show:```[2026-03-15T03:12:21Z] runtime: out of memory allocating KV cache
[2026-03-15T03:12:21Z] runtime: cudaInit failed: CUDA_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED
[2026-03-15T03:12:22Z] modelcache: failed to mmap seedfile: ENOSPC
```

ashley: confirmed customer-facing 5xx spikes from dedicated clusters. Support reports 12 customers seeing degraded latency, 3 with disconnects. Not full outages but requests failing intermittently.

support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-032 (ephemeral-storage-evictions). Priority: P1. Linked PagerDuty incident PD12345.

maya: immediate mitigation ideas: cordon node, drain non-critical pods, delete large old logs under /var/log/redwood/*, and disable model prefetch service on that node.

kyle: I'm running `kubectl cordon gpu-node-7` and start draining runtime pods one at a time with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

infra-bot: Note: draining will trigger model cache downloads on other nodes; recommend lowering prefetch parallelism first. Config snippet to flip:```apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  prefetch_parallelism: "2"
```

jordan: Reducing prefetch_parallelism now via rollout to modelcache configmap. Patch applied.

maya: removing 30GB of rotated logs from /var/log/redwood/old-logs/* on gpu-node-7 to free space. Command used: `ssh ops@gpu-node-7 'rm -rf /var/log/redwood/old-logs/*'`. Freed ~28GB.

kyle: drained 4 runtime pods; restarting each on alternate nodes. Observed one pod crash on startup with `CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN` immediately after moving. Likely leftover local state.

jordan: pushed a temporary eviction-protection QoS tweak to runtime statefulsets: set `ephemeral-storage` requests to 1Gi and limits to 20Gi to make kubelet less likely to evict. This is a short-term mitigation until we clean up.

maya: also disabled verbose debug logging for modelcache on affected nodes to stop log bloat. Config change rolled.

infra-bot: Kernel dmesg shows repeated writeback stalls before evictions:```[ 1234.567890] writeback: 3456 pages dirty, 0 pages writeback
[ 1234.568000] VFS: busy with anon mapping, cannot reclaim
```

netops: noticed underlying instance had a full /tmp mount due to core dumps from previous crashes. Purged cores (`/tmp/core.*`) and truncated runaway logs. Freed ~12GB.

maya: after cleanups, node becomes schedulable again. Uncordoning. Monitoring for further evictions.

kyle: monitoring pod restarts + CUDA errors. So far restarts are healthy; no further ENOSPC.

support-bot: Customer impact update: 12 affected customers degraded -> now down to 2 intermittent failures. Support has notified top 3 affected accounts with a brief status.

jordan: adding a temporary autoscale policy to Dedicated cluster to shift some modelcache requests to cpu-backed nodes to reduce GPU node disk pressure. Patch applied.

maya: will keep this thread as primary coordination. Next steps: follow-up postmortem, add eviction alert with earlier threshold, ensure log rotation enforces max-size 200M, and add node-level prefetch cap.

ashley: assigning follow-ups: @kyle to write runbook step for emergency log purge, @jordan for prefetch throttling permanent config, @maya to draft customer comms.

kyle: putting runbook PR together now -> https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/429 :thumbsup:

maya: handing off to night oncall @netops for watch. If reoccurs, escalate to SRE lead.

netops: acked - I'm on watch for the next 8 hours. I'll post any anomaly here and escalate if eviction rate > 2/min.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 updated: status -> mitigated, responders -> @maya, @kyle, @jordan, @netops.

ashley: thanks team. We'll close after 4 hours stable. Please include logs and exact disk usage numbers in the postmortem.

maya: copying key artifacts to incident ticket: kube events, dmesg, freed files list, prometheus graphs (ephemeral usage + eviction_count) and timeline of config changes.

kyle: quick note: root cause appears to be combination of aggressive model prefetch + un-rotated debug logs plus a previous core-dump flood. We'll validate and include specific sequence in postmortem.

jordan: moving link to playbook items to follow-up checklist in INC-2026-032.

netops: monitoring looks quiet. Marking handoff stable at 03:42 UTC.

support-bot: Final: customers restored to normal for now. Incident set to "monitoring" and will transition to postmortem phase. :white_check_mark:
